history: Kaifeng, ancient Bianliang, capital of eight dynasties. Northern Song's Dongjing was the world's largest city — exactly the prosperity painted in 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'. Six ancient cities lie stacked beneath the streets, a 'city upon city' wonder. The Iron Pagoda, Dragon Pavilion and Daxiangguo Temple tell a thousand years of tales; the night-market snacks run from Song times to today.
importance: Capital of eight dynasties · The real city of the Qingming Scroll
foods: First House soup dumplings — 'open a window first, then drink the soup'.
Ma Yuxing's barrel chicken — salty, fragrant, tender and crisp.
Sweet-sour carp under stretched noodles — 'eat the dragon's flesh, then its whiskers'.
Peanut candy of the Drum Tower night market, melts in the mouth.
Almond tea of the palace — sweet and warming.
Stir-fried cold jelly, garlicky and crispy.
Qi County sweet mashed sweet potato, fine and smooth.
Duck stuffed with chicken, pigeon and quail — a Henan-cuisine marvel.
scenes: Live theme park of the Qingming Scroll.
Imperial complex at the end of the Song Royal Avenue.
A glazed pagoda of 1049 — Kaifeng's landmark.
Northern Song royal temple where Lu Zhishen uprooted a willow.
Lord Bao trial shows and prefecture culture.
A thousand-year night-market tradition at Drum Tower square.
Qing-dynasty 'three carvings' — brick, wood and stone.
A Northern Song hexagonal brick pagoda 'with ten thousand Buddhas'.
